title: 3D Ultrasound for the Imaging of Lymph Nodes in Patients With Breast Cancer
official: 3D Ultrasound Imaging of the Axillary Lymph Nodes
summary: This early phase I studies how well a new 3D ultrasound (3D-US) imaging technology works in evaluating lymph nodes in patients with breast cancer. Ultrasound uses high-frequency sound waves to generate images of the body.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with lymph node biopsy or lymph node clip placement as per routine clinical care.
* Age of 18 or older.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Vulnerable subjects such as prisoners and adults lacking capacity to consent.
